sentences.text: The Girl with Green Eyes
Greg is a porter at the Shepton Hotel in New York.
sentences.translation: غريغ هو عامل في فندق شبتون في نيويورك.

sentences.text: After work, he always goes for a coffee across the street.
sentences.translation: بعد العمل، يذهب دائماً لتناول القهوة في الجانب الآخر من الشارع.

sentences.text: A girl is sitting in the coffee shop, near the window.
sentences.translation: تجلس فتاة في مقهى القهوة، بالقرب من النافذة.

sentences.text: 'It's her again!' thinks Greg.
'She's here every afternoon.'
'I'm going to say hello.'
Greg goes into the coffee shop and gets a coffee.
sentences.translation: يدخل غريغ إلى مقهى القهوة ويحصل على قهوة.

sentences.text: Then he goes across to the girl's table.
'Hi!' he says.
'I'm Greg. Can I sit with you?'
'OK,' she says.
'I'm Cassie.'
'I come here for a coffee every day after work,' says Greg.
sentences.translation: 'آتي إلى هنا لتناول القهوة كل يوم بعد العمل،' يقول غريغ.

sentences.text: 'I'm a porter at the Shepton Hotel.'
He smiles.
'You have beautiful green eyes.'
'Have I?' she says.
She doesn't smile.
'Is something wrong, Cassie?' he asks.
sentences.translation: 'هل هناك خطب ما يا كاسي؟' يسأل.

sentences.text: 'You don't look very happy.'
'It - it's nothing,' she says.
'Tell me,' says Greg.
'Maybe I can help?'
'Well...' she begins.
'Go on,' says Greg.
'My stepfather is staying at the Shepton Hotel,' she says.
sentences.translation: 'زوج أمي يقيم في فندق شبتون،' تقول.

sentences.text: 'He has my sketch books.'
'I'm an artist.'
When I ask him to give them to me he says, 'No.
sentences.translation: عندما أطلب منه أن يعطيني إياها يقول، 'لا.

sentences.text: I want you to come back home to Boston.'
sentences.translation: أريدك أن تعودي إلى المنزل في بوسطن.'

sentences.text: But I don't want to go back to Boston.
sentences.translation: لكني لا أريد العودة إلى بوسطن.

sentences.text: He's not nice.'
'How long is he going to be at the hotel?' asks Greg.
sentences.translation: 'كم من الوقت سيبقى في الفندق؟' يسأل غريغ.

sentences.text: 'Two more days,' says Cassie.
'He's in room 724.'
'Maybe I can get the sketch books for you,' says Greg.
sentences.translation: 'ربما يمكنني إحضار دفاتر الرسومات لك،' يقول غريغ.

sentences.text: 'Maybe I can get into his room.'
'Can you?' she says.
'Meet me here tomorrow afternoon at 4.30,' says Greg.
sentences.translation: 'قابليني هنا غداً بعد الظهر في الساعة 4:30،' يقول غريغ.

sentences.text: 'OK, thank you!' says Cassie.
'Thank you very much.'
She looks at her watch.
'I've got to go now.
See you tomorrow.'
When Cassie gets back to her hotel room, she makes a telephone call.
sentences.translation: عندما تعود كاسي إلى غرفتها في الفندق، تجري مكالمة هاتفية.

sentences.text: 'Hello,' she says.
'It's me.
It's OK, the boy's going to do it...
Yes, I'm going to get them from him tomorrow afternoon...
sentences.translation: نعم، سأحصل عليها منه غداً بعد الظهر...

sentences.text: OK, I can meet you there the morning after, at 10am.
sentences.translation: حسناً، يمكنني مقابلتك هناك في صباح اليوم التالي، في الساعة 10 صباحاً.

sentences.text: Don't forget to bring the money - two thousand dollars.'
sentences.translation: لا تنسى إحضار المال - ألفي دولار.'

sentences.text: Next morning, Greg arrives at work early.
sentences.translation: في صباح اليوم التالي، يصل غريغ إلى العمل مبكراً.

sentences.text: He goes to find room 724.
'I have to wait for Cassie's stepfather to go out,' he thinks.
sentences.translation: 'يجب أن أنتظر خروج زوج أم كاسي،' يفكر.

sentences.text: 'I don't know his name, but it doesn't matter.'
sentences.translation: 'لا أعرف اسمه، لكن هذا لا يهم.'

sentences.text: Greg watches the door of room 724.
He sees the girl come to clean the rooms.
Some minutes later, a man comes out of room 724.
sentences.translation: بعد بضع دقائق، يخرج رجل من الغرفة 724.

sentences.text: 'That must be Cassie's stepfather!' thinks Greg.
sentences.translation: 'لا بد أن هذا زوج أم كاسي!' يفكر غريغ.

sentences.text: He waits for the man to leave, and for the cleaning girl to go into room 724.
sentences.translation: ينتظر الرجل حتى يغادر، وحتى تدخل فتاة التنظيف إلى الغرفة 724.

sentences.text: 'I need to look in the room,' he thinks.
Greg waits for the girl to leave the bedroom, then he goes into the room and begins to look for the sketch books.
sentences.translation: ينتظر غريغ الفتاة حتى تخرج من غرفة النوم، ثم يدخل الغرفة ويبدأ في البحث عن دفاتر الرسومات.

sentences.text: 'I must be quick,' he thinks.
'Where are they?'
Suddenly, Greg sees the sketch books by the bed.
sentences.translation: فجأة، يرى غريغ دفاتر الرسومات بجانب السرير.

sentences.text: 'Got them!' he thinks.
He begins to look at the pictures.
'Wow! Cassie is a great artist!
These are good!'
Greg is leaving the room when he hears the cleaning girl call out to him.
sentences.translation: كان غريغ يغادر الغرفة عندما سمع فتاة التنظيف تناديه.

sentences.text: 'Hey!' she says.
'What are you doing? Come back!'
Greg does not stop.
Greg finishes work that afternoon and leaves the hotel through a door in the next street.
sentences.translation: ينهي غريغ عمله ذلك المساء ويغادر الفندق عبر باب في الشارع المجاور.

sentences.text: When he gets near the front of the hotel, he sees the man from room 724.
sentences.translation: عندما يقترب من واجهة الفندق، يرى الرجل من الغرفة 724.

sentences.text: 'That's him again!' thinks Greg.
'That's Cassie's stepfather.'
Greg waits for the man to go into the hotel, then he goes to the coffee shop.
sentences.translation: ينتظر غريغ الرجل حتى يدخل الفندق، ثم يذهب إلى مقهى القهوة.

sentences.text: Cassie is at the same table in the coffee shop.
sentences.translation: كاسي على نفس الطاولة في مقهى القهوة.

sentences.text: Greg gets a coffee and goes to sit with her.
sentences.translation: يحصل غريغ على قهوة ويذهب للجلوس معها.

sentences.text: 'I have them,' he says, and he puts the sketch books on the table.
sentences.translation: 'لديّ إياها،' يقول، ويضع دفاتر الرسومات على الطاولة.

sentences.text: 'That's great!' says Cassie.
'How can I thank you, Greg?'
'You can meet me later,' he says.
'After I go home and change out of my porter's uniform.'
sentences.translation: 'بعد أن أعود إلى المنزل وأغير زي العامل الخاص بي.'

sentences.text: 'I'm sorry, Greg,' says Cassie.
'I can't tonight.
Maybe tomorrow night.'
'OK,' says Greg.
'Tomorrow night.
We can get something to eat, first.'
'Yes, OK,' says Cassie.
'I have to go now, but meet me here tomorrow evening at six o'clock.'
sentences.translation: 'يجب أن أذهب الآن، لكن قابلني هنا غداً مساءً في الساعة السادسة.'

sentences.text: Cassie gets up, ready to leave.
'Don't forget your key,' says Greg.
'Oh - er - thanks,' says Cassie.
She takes it from him quickly.
'See you tomorrow.'
Greg is finishing his coffee when he sees his friend, Mike.
sentences.translation: كان غريغ ينهي قهوته عندما رأى صديقه مايك.

sentences.text: 'You're in trouble, Greg,' says Mike.
sentences.translation: 'أنت في مشكلة يا غريغ،' يقول مايك.

sentences.text: 'Jake Russo's sketch books are not in his room - room 724.'
sentences.translation: 'دفاتر رسومات جيك روسو ليست في غرفته - الغرفة 724.'

sentences.text: 'And there are CCTV pictures of you coming from that room.'
sentences.translation: 'وهناك صور كاميرات مراقبة لك تخرج من تلك الغرفة.'

sentences.text: 'Wh - who is Jake Russo?' asks Greg.
sentences.translation: 'م- من هو جيك روسو؟' يسأل غريغ.

sentences.text: Suddenly he's not feeling very well.
sentences.translation: فجأة لم يعد يشعر بحالة جيدة.

sentences.text: 'An artist,' says Mike.
'His pictures sell for thousands of dollars.
And his sketch books sell for thousands, too.'
'Do you have them?' asks Mike.
'No - er - a girl has them,' says Greg.
sentences.translation: 'لا - آه - فتاة لديها إياها،' يقول غريغ.

sentences.text: 'What girl?' asks Mike.
'A girl with green eyes,' says Greg.
And he tells Mike about Cassie and her stepfather.
sentences.translation: ويخبر مايك عن كاسي وزوج أمها.

sentences.text: 'But it's not true!' says Mike, when Greg finishes speaking.
sentences.translation: 'لكن هذا ليس صحيحاً!' يقول مايك، عندما ينتهي غريغ من الكلام.

sentences.text: 'Jake Russo doesn't have a wife or a stepdaughter.'
sentences.translation: 'جيك روسو ليس لديه زوجة أو ربيبة.'

sentences.text: You have to find that girl and get the sketch books, Greg.
sentences.translation: يجب أن تجد تلك الفتاة وتحضر دفاتر الرسومات يا غريغ.

sentences.text: And you have to do it before the police find you!'
sentences.translation: وعليك أن تفعل ذلك قبل أن تجدك الشرطة!'

sentences.text: Greg walks home to his one-room apartment.
sentences.translation: يمشي غريغ إلى منزله، شقة من غرفة واحدة.

sentences.text: 'How am I going to find her?' he thinks.
'She has Jake Russo's sketch books now, so she's not going to meet me again.
sentences.translation: 'لديها دفاتر رسومات جيك روسو الآن، لذا لن تقابلني مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: Is she going to sell them for a lot of money?'
sentences.translation: هل ستبيعها مقابل الكثير من المال؟'

sentences.text: There is a police car in the street, next to Greg's apartment.
sentences.translation: هناك سيارة شرطة في الشارع، بجوار شقة غريغ.

sentences.text: 'Oh, no!' he thinks.
'They're waiting for me.
I can't get into my apartment now.'
sentences.translation: لا يمكنني الدخول إلى شقتي الآن.'

sentences.text: That night, Greg sleeps on a train in the subway.
sentences.translation: في تلك الليلة، ينام غريغ في قطار في مترو الأنفاق.

sentences.text: But early the next morning...
sentences.translation: لكن في صباح اليوم التالي مبكراً...

sentences.text: 'Hey, you!' says a man.
He's the subway cleaner.
'Get up! You can't sleep here all day!'
sentences.translation: 'استيقظ! لا يمكنك النوم هنا طوال اليوم!'

sentences.text: 'Sorry,' says Greg.
People are arriving to get their trains now.
One of them stops and looks at a photograph in his newspaper - and then at Greg.
sentences.translation: يتوقف أحدهم وينظر إلى صورة في صحيفته - ثم إلى غريغ.

sentences.text: 'It's him,' thinks the man.
'It's the young man in the newspaper photograph.
The police are looking for him.'
Suddenly, Greg sees the man looking at him.
sentences.translation: فجأة، يرى غريغ الرجل ينظر إليه.

sentences.text: And he sees his picture on the front of the man's newspaper.
sentences.translation: ويرى صورته على واجهة صحيفة الرجل.

sentences.text: 'I have to get out of here quickly!' he thinks.
sentences.translation: 'يجب أن أخرج من هنا بسرعة!' يفكر.

sentences.text: The man with the newspaper finds a policeman.
sentences.translation: يجد الرجل الذي يحمل الصحيفة شرطياً.

sentences.text: 'It's him!' he tells the policeman.
'The hotel porter!'
'Hey, you!' the policeman calls to Greg.
Greg runs.
'Stop!' calls the policeman.
Greg doesn't stop.
'I have to get out of this uniform,' thinks Greg.
sentences.translation: 'يجب أن أتخلص من هذا الزي،' يفكر غريغ.

sentences.text: 'People know I'm the porter.
Maybe Mike can give me something different to wear.'
sentences.translation: ربما يمكن لمايك أن يعطيني شيئاً مختلفاً لأرتديه.'

sentences.text: When he gets to Mike's apartment, Mike opens the door.
sentences.translation: عندما يصل إلى شقة مايك، يفتح مايك الباب.

sentences.text: 'I need something to wear,' Greg tells him.
'I can't go back to my apartment.
My picture's in the newspaper, and -'
'Yes, I know,' says Mike.
'It's OK. Come in.'
'Where's the girl?' asks Mike.
'Do you know?'
'No,' says Greg.
'What can you remember about her?' says Mike.
'There must be something to help you find her.'
sentences.translation: 'لا بد أن هناك شيئاً يساعدك في العثور عليها.'

sentences.text: 'Yes!' Greg says, suddenly.
'Her key! A key to a room in the Dolphin Hotel!'
'It's a small, cheap hotel near 42nd Street.
sentences.translation: 'إنه فندق صغير ورخيص بالقرب من شارع 42.

sentences.text: She must be staying there.
What's the time?'
'Nearly nine o'clock,' says Mike.
'Maybe she's there now,' says Greg.
'I have to go! Thanks, Mike.'
Twenty minutes later, Greg is near the Dolphin Hotel.
sentences.translation: بعد عشرين دقيقة، يكون غريغ بالقرب من فندق دولفين.

sentences.text: 'Am I too late?' he thinks.
Suddenly, Greg sees Cassie come out of the hotel.
sentences.translation: فجأة، يرى غريغ كاسي تخرج من الفندق.

sentences.text: 'Cassie!' he calls.
'Wait! I have to talk to you!'
Cassie sees him, but she doesn't stop.
sentences.translation: ترى كاسي غريغ، لكنها لا تتوقف.

sentences.text: There is a car waiting for her.
She says something to the driver and gets into it quickly.
'Oh, no!' says Greg.
'Pier 83,' says an old man in the street.
Greg looks at him.
'What?'
'The girl is going to Pier 83, West 42nd Street, for the Circle Line boat,' says the old man.
sentences.translation: 'الفتاة ذاهبة إلى الرصيف 83، شارع 42 غرباً، لقارب دائرة الخط،' يقول الرجل العجوز.

sentences.text: Greg smiles.
'Thanks!' he says.
And he begins to run.
Greg runs all the way to Pier 83.
sentences.translation: يركض غريغ طوال الطريق إلى الرصيف 83.

sentences.text: People are getting on to the boat, and he gets a ticket.
sentences.translation: الناس يستقلون القارب، ويحصل على تذكرة.

sentences.text: On the boat, Greg looks for Cassie.
sentences.translation: على القارب، يبحث غريغ عن كاسي.

sentences.text: But a woman with a newspaper is looking at him.
sentences.translation: لكن امرأة تحمل صحيفة تنظر إليه.

sentences.text: 'It's the young man in the picture!' she tells the man with her.
sentences.translation: 'إنه الشاب في الصورة!' تخبر الرجل الذي معها.

sentences.text: 'Call the police, Eddie.'
The man gets his phone and calls the police.
Some time later, Greg sees Cassie.
sentences.translation: بعد مرور بعض الوقت، يرى غريغ كاسي.

sentences.text: She is talking to a man.
But Greg does not see two policemen get on the boat.
sentences.translation: لكن غريغ لا يرى شرطيين يستقلان القارب.

sentences.text: They quickly find Greg.
'Where are Jake Russo's sketch books?' the first policeman asks him.
sentences.translation: 'أين دفاتر رسومات جيك روسو؟' يسأله الشرطي الأول.

sentences.text: 'I don't have them!' says Greg.
'You don't want me! You want her!
She has the sketch books.'
'Hey, look! He's right,' says the second policeman.
sentences.translation: 'يا، انظروا! إنه محق،' يقول الشرطي الثاني.

sentences.text: The two policemen move quickly to Cassie and the man.
sentences.translation: يتحرك الشرطيان بسرعة نحو كاسي والرجل.

sentences.text: 'I don't understand,' says Cassie.
'The two of you are coming with us,' says one of the policemen.
'You're in trouble.'
Later, Greg and a policeman take the sketch books back to the hotel.
sentences.translation: لاحقاً، يأخذ غريغ وشرطي دفاتر الرسومات إلى الفندق.

sentences.text: Jake Russo is very happy to see them again.
sentences.translation: جيك روسو سعيد جداً برؤيتهم مرة أخرى.

sentences.text: 'I'm sorry, Mr Russo,' says Greg, and tells him everything.
sentences.translation: 'أنا آسف يا سيد روسو،' يقول غريغ، ويخبره بكل شيء.

sentences.text: 'It's OK,' says the artist, smiling.
'But stay away from girls with beautiful green eyes!'
sentences.translation: 'لكن ابتعد عن الفتيات ذوات العيون الخضراء الجميلة!'

sentences.text: - THE END -
Hope you have enjoyed the reading!
sentences.translation: أتمنى أن تكون قد استمتعت بالقراءة!

sentences.text: Come back to http://english-e-reader.net/ to find more fascinating and exciting stories!
sentences.translation: عد إلى http://english-e-reader.net/ للعثور على المزيد من القصص الرائعة والمثيرة!
